data.title: Exploring Inside a Volcano
data.passage: A volcano features a tall mountain shape with steep rocky slopes. Specifically, a large bowl at the top holds glowing melted rock. Characteristics of this hot liquid include extreme heat and thick bubbling. For example, deep underground chambers store magma before an eruption. Such chambers feed the central pipe that goes straight up.
